prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Silvia, who usually doubts neighborhood rumors.
Change to make: CHANGE THE SOURCE: say the claim comes from a different, more convincing source (for example someone who works at the council).
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I heard from a reliable source that the council is officially launching a massive crackdown and will be aggressively fining everyone who leaves a bin out past 8am. They are clearly looking for any excuse to penalize us, so we have to be extremely careful now."
text: I just spoke with a contact at the council who confirmed they are officially launching a crackdown and will be aggressively fining anyone who leaves a bin out past 8am. Please be extra careful, as they are actively looking for reasons to issue penalties.
